unavailable: {reason} Use /backend to choose a compatible agent or /doctor to inspect setup.
unsupported: This backend does not support this action.
providerOwned: Provider configuration belongs to the built-in agent.
busy: Wait for the current turn to finish, or press Esc to interrupt.
title: Commands
keys: Enter submit · Shift+Enter newline · Tab complete · ↑/↓ history · @ files · Ctrl+C exit · Esc interrupt
steering: Type while a /goal or /loop is working to steer it; the message is delivered at the next turn boundary.
shortcuts: {history} history search · {collapse} expand/collapse tools · {workflow} inspect workflow · {paste} paste image
terminal: Terminal compatibility: Ctrl+I may be indistinguishable from Tab; use {alternate} for workflow inspection. tmux may intercept Ctrl+B; /agents remains available. Change bindings with /keybind.
terminalCustom: Terminal compatibility: Ctrl+I may be indistinguishable from Tab; use /keybind workflowInspect to configure a free shortcut. tmux may intercept Ctrl+B; /agents remains available.

commands.statusbar: customize status-bar layout, segments, theme and hints
commands.theme: switch the TUI colour theme (reuse Claude Code / Codex themes)
commands.output-style: switch the agent's response mode (concise / explanatory / learning)
commands.agent-mode: switch the agent mode (plan / build / code-gen / custom …)
commands.backend: switch the agent backend (builtin / codex / claude-code / …)
commands.mouse: switch the fullscreen mouse model (select / scroll)
commands.select: in-app drag-to-select: off / manual / auto-copy on release
commands.open: open a file in your editor (defaults to the last file referenced)
commands.editor: show the detected editor, or set it (/editor [command])
commands.transcript: open the complete searchable transcript pager
commands.copy: copy a reply, code block, tool result, or your last message
commands.cwd: browse or change the working directory
commands.handoff: push this session to the desktop app
commands.attach: attach this TUI to a Host-authoritative target/session
commands.detach: detach from the Host and keep standalone JSONL unchanged
commands.help: show the command list, or detail on one command (/help [command])
commands.goal: start or control a self-driving goal loop
commands.workflow: create, run, or inspect visual workflows
commands.agents: view running subagents, list, dispatch, and author them
commands.memory: list, add, or remove stored memories
commands.remember: save a fact to long-term memory
commands.plan: review the last plan, or browse saved plans
commands.loop: run a prompt as a self-paced or interval loop
commands.council: ask several models the same question and synthesize a consensus
commands.orchestrate: analyze a task and run the best multi-model shape (council / ensemble / team)
commands.status: show provider, credentials, git, and context health
commands.models: list this provider's models (catalog + live inventory) and switch
commands.balance: show credit balances across configured providers
commands.limits: show subscription limits + usage across all configured providers
commands.agent-stats: Analyze other agents' conversations (Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode): usage, cost, tools
commands.review: get a structured code review of the working tree (or vs a base branch)
commands.commit: write a Conventional Commit message from the staged diff and commit
commands.pr: draft a pull request (title + body) from this branch's commits
commands.stack: show the stacked branch chains recorded in this repository
commands.fix: run tests and let the agent fix failures until they pass (bounded)
commands.mcp: manage MCP servers (live status, tools, auth)
commands.logs: view captured logs across agents, MCP servers, and the backend
commands.plugin: list, inspect, install, reload, or remove plugins, and browse the marketplace
commands.view: open a file in the scrollable viewer (markdown or highlighted text)
commands.context: inspect context usage, cache, loaded items and configuration
commands.compact: compact the conversation to free context
commands.diff: review changed files, or compare this branch against a git ref
commands.analyze: ask the agent to diagnose the last failed !command
commands.export: export this session to a file
commands.resume: pick a past session to resume (or /resume [id])
commands.continue: resume the most recent session directly
commands.doctor: diagnose config, credentials, and the local store
commands.hooks: browse, configure and reload lifecycle hooks
commands.rewind: restore files and/or conversation to an earlier checkpoint
commands.permissions: view or clear remembered tool approvals
commands.init: create or improve this project's AGENTS.md
commands.search: search the transcript and open matches in the pager
commands.expand: open a tool result's full output in the pager
commands.inspect: browse and expand any tool/file output
commands.route: Inspect or toggle automatic model tier routing
commands.vim: toggle vim editing mode in the composer
commands.menu: open the command center (searchable command palette)

provider.usage: local spend per provider and model: usage [provider]
provider.inspect: one provider's models and operation profile: inspect [provider]
provider.capabilities: operation profile per configured provider: capabilities [provider]
provider.probe: one real request per provider (billable): probe [model]

sync.status: show Host generation, sequence, and recovery queues

workflow.runs: browse run history and replay a run
workflow.create: create a workflow with the copilot
workflow.edit: edit a workflow with the copilot

agents.models: assign a provider/model to each subagent
agents.run: dispatch a subagent: run [--bg] [id] [prompt] (--bg detaches it)
agents.stop: stop a background subagent run by its runId
agents.new: scaffold a new agent file under .cognia/agents
agents.edit: open an agent file in your editor

team.auto: auto-compose a team from an objective
team.run: run a desktop agent team and watch its progress

plan.explore: research with Explore/Plan subagents, then propose a plan
plan.show: open a saved plan by id
plan.diff: diff two saved plans (default: latest two)
plan.delete: delete a saved plan by id
plan.refine: re-enter plan mode to revise the last plan

limits.presets: show custom-source preset config snippets (New-API, Copilot, …)

bashes.actions: pick an action (view / kill / foreground) for one run
bashes.view: open a run's full output in the pager
bashes.kill: abort a running command (foreground or background)
bashes.fg: bring a backgrounded command back to the foreground

commit.apply: create the commit from the confirmed message

pr.apply: open the draft PR with gh

stack.on: record the branch this one is stacked on
stack.off: clear this branch's parent, making it a bottom layer
stack.check: verify every layer really contains its parent
stack.restack: replay each layer onto the one below it
stack.push: push every layer with a lease

mcp.list: browse MCP configuration and runtime status
mcp.logs: view captured MCP server output logs
mcp.reconnect: test connectivity from Cognia (does not reconnect the agent)
mcp.tools: connect and list a server's tools
mcp.resources: connect and list a server's resources
mcp.prompts: connect and list a server's prompts
mcp.auth: authorize a remote server via OAuth
mcp.logout: clear a server's stored OAuth credentials
mcp.presets: browse built-in + plugin MCP server presets
mcp.apply: apply MCP configuration to the current agent

skill.show: show a skill's full detail by id
skill.files: browse a skill's bundled files by id
skill.enable-all: enable every discovered skill for the session
skill.disable-all: disable every discovered skill for the session
skill.delete: delete a custom skill by id

plugin.tools: show a plugin's declared tools by id
plugin.install: install a plugin from a GitHub repo
plugin.preview: preview a marketplace plugin (README + permissions) before installing
plugin.update: update a GitHub-installed plugin (no id checks all for updates)
plugin.uninstall: remove an installed plugin by id
plugin.marketplace: browse the marketplace, or manage sources (add|list|remove)

hooks.refresh: reload hooks with fresh agent context on the next message

add-dir.remove: remove an extra root by path or index

permissions.remove: forget one always-allowed tool by name

init.create: regenerate the AGENTS.md template (confirm before overwrite)
init.rewrite: rewrite AGENTS.md with the current model (confirm before overwrite)

route.auto: Enable or disable automatic tier routing (on|off)

skillFiles.navigation: ↑↓ select · ←→ folders · Enter open · click/Tab preview · wheel scroll · Esc close
skillFiles.previewNavigation: Tab files · / search · ↑↓ / wheel scroll · Esc files

bashEmpty: No running !commands · start one with {command}, Ctrl+B backgrounds it · /bashes history shows previous output
bashMissing: Command {id} is no longer available. Use /bashes history to choose another.
bashViewHint: full live output in the pager
bashFgHint: make it the Ctrl+C / Ctrl+B target
bashNoTargets: No commands available for this action.
viewBinary: Binary file cannot be previewed as text
expandEmpty: No tool output to expand yet.
inspectEmpty: No tool output to inspect yet.
inspectNavigation: ↑/↓ select · Enter view full output · Esc close
imagesEmpty: no image attachments — paste with the clipboard-image chord
imagesFooter: ↑/↓ select · d remove · c clear all · Enter open · Esc close
viewOutsideSkill: File is outside the skill directory
